description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IWebAudioPlayerIpc class, which provides IPC APIs for web audio playback in the Rialto client. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and documentation comments.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IWebAudioPlayerIpc instances, providing a method to get the factory instance and to create IPC objects.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpc
classes.description: Interface defining IPC methods for web audio playback, including play, pause, setEos, buffer management, device info, volume control, etc.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton factory instance for creating IWebAudioPlayerIpc objects.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Creates a new IWebAudioPlayerIpc object with specified client, mime type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Notifies end of stream to the IPC.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available frames and shared memory info for writing audio data.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes a specified number of audio frames to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info including preferred frames, maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for audio attenuation.
